title: Atliera owner decision record (v2 — externally ratified, append-only)
description: The only form in which an owner decision exists. v1 permitted a schema-valid 'effective' record whose owner identity and attestation were self-asserted free text; v2 replaces that with a ratification envelope binding a verified external event to an immutable proposal digest and subject SHA. Agents may author records only in state 'proposed'. There is no grandfathering path: pre-v2 decisions remain documented historical facts and are not re-validated as machine-checkable authority. A record is never edited in place: ratification adds an envelope, and a later decision supersedes an earlier one through explicit predecessor/successor linkage.

recordId.description: Stable id for this decision; supersession links reference it.

state.description: proposed: drafted (by anyone, including an agent); confers no authority. ratified: an owner ratification envelope is attached and verified — this is the only authoritative state. superseded: a later record supersedes it. 'effective' from v1 is not accepted; see grandfathering below.

decision.description: The decision itself, one plain statement.

scope.description: What the decision governs (milestone, artifact hash, account, gate).

boundSha.description: Full commit SHA the decision was made against. Abbreviated SHAs are not accepted: an owner decision names an immutable subject.

proposalDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized proposal fields (kind, schemaVersion, recordId, decision, scope, boundSha). Ratification binds THIS digest, so the decision text cannot change after ratification without invalidating the envelope.

advisoryInputs.description: Briefs/reviews consulted. Listing an input never substitutes for ratification.

method.description: An externally verifiable event performed under the owner's own identity. Free-text 'verbatim-statement' is NOT a ratification method in v2 — it may be recorded in advisoryInputs, but authority requires a verifiable event.

ownerIdentity.description: The verified account/login that performed the event.

eventUrl.description: Immutable URL of the approval/review event.

eventId.description: Provider-assigned immutable id for the event.

ratification.description: Required for state 'ratified'; forbidden in state 'proposed'.

supersedes.description: recordId of the decision this one replaces.

supersededBy.description: recordId of the decision that replaced this one; set only alongside state 'superseded'.
